repair_progression: 25/28 after persistent action/proposition group state, interruption restoration, correction-aware source membership, and structural state/completion paraphrases
28/28 after word-boundary-safe state detection, English took-care completion recognition, and Korean discourse-repair actor extraction

mechanisms: Conversation state schema 18 stores bounded, hash-bound action and attributed-proposition discourse groups separately from semantic concept payloads.
An action group retains exact goal membership across at least five neutral interruptions and resolves only when requested cardinality is valid.
An established two-source proposition group survives later third-speaker material when an explicit historical group expression is used.
Proposition group members are source identities; resolution selects the newest active proposition for each member so explicit corrections replace stale content.
English action-state terms require lexical boundaries, preventing statement from activating the state query route.
Completion reports remain unverified language reports, while progress/status forms remain non-mutating queries.
Group state carries neither semantic authority nor external execution authority, and rehashed authority tampering is rejected.
residual_limits: This is bounded deterministic language engineering and does not establish GPT-level general language competence.
Only action and attributed-proposition group kinds are persistent; arbitrary nested, overlapping, and open-world discourse sets are not yet modeled.
Persistent groups are bounded to eight groups and sixteen turns, with compact inspectable Korean and English paraphrase vocabularies.
Topic-return operations do not yet reactivate arbitrary historical group stacks or resolve unrestricted associative bridging.
Natural realization remains structurally faithful but less varied and conversational than a generative language model.
next_program_order: typed nested and overlapping discourse sets with explicit membership revision
topic-linked group suspension and restoration across longer dialogue
broader compositional pragmatic paraphrases without lexical substring routing
more natural evidence-grounded realization while preserving claim-level provenance
